summary: Full E2E test of refactored Centro Social de Brito v2 (3 admins by name, 5 destinations, no creche, new bookings feature). Backend: 22/22 pytest passed. Frontend: all critical flows verified (home 3 tiles, /entrada with 5 locations, /marcar full booking submission, /login by name, /dashboard with 5-location stats, /marcacoes admin with conclude/cancel/delete actions). 0 critical issues.

issues: Date and time inputs use browser-native pickers (input type=date/time) instead of shadcn Calendar component — guideline preference, not a functional bug
GET /api/auth/me returns 401 on unauthenticated public pages (Home, /entrada, /marcar) — pollutes browser console; consider suppressing or only fetching me when token exists

action_items: Optional: replace native date/time pickers in BookingPage and HistoryPage with shadcn Calendar/TimePicker for design consistency
Optional: skip GET /api/auth/me when no session_token exists in localStorage to avoid noisy 401s in console
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~590 lines and handles auth + visits + bookings + stats — close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/visits.py, routers/bookings.py, routers/auth.py before further growth.

ADMIN_USERS hard-coded in source with plain-text passwords (sede123 etc.). This is acceptable for an internal kiosk but should at minimum live in /app/backend/.env (e.g. ADMIN_PASSWORDS_JSON) so passwords can be rotated without a code deploy.
/api/visits/checkin is fully public (no auth) — anyone with the URL can spam the visits collection. Same for /api/bookings. Consider adding a simple kiosk token or rate limit.
BookingCreate has no validation that data_hora is not unrealistically far in future (e.g. year 9999) and does not clamp seconds.
stats endpoint does N+1 count_documents calls (5 locations + 7 days = 12 round trips). Could be a single $facet aggregation; minor at current volume.
Migration on startup (creche -> secretaria_sede, lar -> lar_residencial) runs on every boot. Idempotent so safe, but log/metric the count migrated.
No DELETE/cancel endpoint for visits — only checkout. If an entry is created by mistake there is no admin recovery path.
expires_at TTL is set as a Python datetime (BSON Date) for new docs but the backfill loop also uses datetime — consistent. Good.
test_credentials: Erpi Sede / sede123 (verified). Erpi Parais / paraiso123 and Lar Residencial / larresidencial123 also verified via backend tests.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed visits and bookings (TEST_UI_Visitante, TEST_BookingUser, TEST_Conclude, TEST_Delete). Some are auto-cleaned by tests (DELETE /api/bookings/{id}); others remain in the DB but marked TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor v2 verified end-to-end. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_brito_v2.py covers all 3 admin logins, /api/locations (5 keys, no creche), checkin with new+legacy+invalid locations, bookings CRUD (create/list/filter/conclude/cancel/delete), past-date rejection, admin auth gating. Frontend Playwright covered: home tiles, /entrada 5-location selection, /marcar submission with future date, admin login by name, dashboard 'por local' with 5 keys, marcacoes filters and action buttons (conclude/cancel/delete). Google OAuth flow not tested (requires real session id).
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Implementation matches the refactor spec: admin login by name (not email), 5 destinations replacing creche/lar, public bookings feature with future-date validation, admin-only management endpoints. Migration of legacy 'creche'/'lar' instituicao values runs on startup.
